annotations.annotation_text: Liturgical or ecclesiastical allusion (Amen): weaving Catholic ritual, Latin prayers, and sacramental language into the domestic nighttime dream.
Mythological and folkloric archetype (Patrick): invoking the ancient Fianna cycle, heroic legend, and the patron saints of early Celtic Christianity.
sources: MacKillop, James. Dictionary of Celtic Mythology. https://www.oxfordreference.com
Lady Gregory. Gods and Fighting Men. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/14465

annotations.annotation_text: The eternal fraternal dialectic between the opposing sons Shem the Penman (the artist/introvert/outcast) and Shaun the Post (the priest/governor/materialist), embodied in "Shaun".
sources: Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
